spec.title: HashiStack / Vault
spec.description: Vault seal/HA state, request load and latency, tokens and leases, PKI issuance per mount, integrated-storage (raft) health and runtime.

spec.title: Sealed
spec.description: Sealed Vault servers (alert VaultSealed after 1m).

spec.title: Active nodes
spec.description: Servers in active (not standby) mode. Must be exactly 1.

spec.title: Autopilot unhealthy
spec.description: Alert VaultAutopilotUnhealthy after 5m.

spec.title: Failure tolerance
spec.description: Raft peers that can fail without losing quorum.

spec.title: Requests /s
spec.description: Authenticated requests handled.

spec.title: Error ratio
spec.description: 4xx + 5xx share of responses. A rise usually means an expired token or a denied policy path.

spec.title: In-flight requests
spec.description: Requests being processed now.

spec.title: Leases
spec.description: Leases tracked by the expiration manager.

spec.title: Irrevocable leases
spec.description: Leases Vault failed to revoke; their secrets stay live until cleaned up.

spec.title: Identity entities
spec.description: Identity entities.

spec.title: Raft FSM pending
spec.description: Committed raft entries not yet applied to the FSM.

spec.title: Expiration queue
spec.description: Lease expirations waiting for a worker.

spec.title: Request rate
spec.description: Requests and logins per second.

spec.title: Request latency
spec.description: handle_request latency.

spec.title: Responses by status code
spec.description: Responses by HTTP status. A steady 403 stream is a client retrying with a token or policy that no longer grants the path; 429 is rate limiting.

spec.title: Certificates issued per mount
spec.description: Issue/sign calls per PKI mount: vault-agent renewals, Connect leaf signing, reader certs.

spec.title: PKI issue latency p99
spec.description: Key generation + signing time per mount.

spec.title: Token operations
spec.description: Token churn. A creation spike with no matching revokes grows the lease table.

spec.title: Leases
spec.description: Lease count over time.

spec.title: Lease revocations
spec.description: Lease revocations and token renewals.

spec.title: Raft commit / storage latency p99
spec.description: Integrated storage latency. NaN gaps = no operations in the interval.

spec.title: Raft index
spec.description: Write rate into the raft log.

spec.title: Goroutines
spec.description: Vault goroutines.

spec.title: Heap allocated
spec.description: Go heap in use.

spec.title: GC pause
spec.description: Fraction of wall time spent in GC pauses.
